editorialSummary.heading: Two half days, with a Tuesday return after winter break

January 4 is a teacher workday with no school for students, so the third nine weeks begins Tuesday, January 5. Pickup times vary by campus. Brown-Barge Middle, Bailey Middle and Pensacola High publish different early dismissals, making the school’s own schedule the best guide for afternoon transportation and care.

The year begins Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Fall break gives students November 23-27 away from regular classes, including Thanksgiving. Spring break is March 22-26, 2027, with classes scheduled to resume March 29. The fourth nine weeks starts March 15, leaving a full school week before that vacation. Separate professional-development days keep students out October 12, February 15 and April 16. The district prints 178 student days and notes that break days may be used for make-up instruction. Keep school messages handy if weather interrupts the schedule.

faqs.question: When does school start in Escambia County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Students begin Wednesday, August 12, 2026. Employee workdays before that date are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Tuesday, May 25, 2027, and it is a half day. It also ends the fourth nine weeks. Check your school’s dismissal time before arranging pickup.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break: November 23-27, 2026. Including the surrounding weekends, students are scheduled away from regular classes November 21-29, 2026 and return Monday, November 30, 2026. Break days may be used for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in 2027?
faqs.answer: Christmas break is December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027. January 4 is a teacher workday with no school for students, so students return Tuesday, January 5. December 18 is a half day before the break. The continuous time away from regular classes is December 19-January 4 under the published schedule.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 22-26, 2027. The scheduled return is Monday, March 29, 2027. With both weekends, the planned time away from regular classes is March 20-28, 2027. The district may use break days for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: Does the fourth nine weeks begin after spring break?
faqs.answer: No. The fourth nine weeks begins March 15, 2027. March 15-19 is a regular school week before the March 22-26 spring break.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-development days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on the October 12, 2026, February 15, 2027, and April 16 professional-development days. January 4 is a separate teacher workday with no school for students.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day and Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes on Labor Day, September 7, 2026, or Veterans Day, November 11, 2026.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Is Presidents Day a student holiday?
faqs.answer: Students have no school on Monday, February 15, 2027. The calendar labels that date a Professional Development Day, rather than a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Which dates are half days?
faqs.answer: The two half days are December 18, 2026, and May 25, 2027. Students attend on both dates; neither is a full day off.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on half days?
faqs.answer: Dismissal varies by school. For 2026-2027, Brown-Barge Middle lists 12:15 p.m., Bailey Middle lists 1:10 p.m. and Pensacola High lists 1:20 p.m. These are campus-specific times in Central Time. Confirm your own school’s pickup and bus arrangements.

faqs.question: What are regular school start and dismissal times?
faqs.answer: Brown-Barge Middle lists an 8:40 a.m. first bell and 3:25 p.m. dismissal. Bailey Middle’s first period begins at 9:34 a.m., with dismissal at 4:16 p.m. Pensacola High lists an 8:25 a.m. first bell and 3:10 p.m. dismissal. These current school schedules are not a single districtwide bell schedule.

faqs.question: How many student days are on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The district prints 178 student days. Half days remain student attendance dates. The published schedule may change if break days are needed for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 9, 2026; December 18, 2026; March 12, 2027; and May 25, 2027. The second and fourth endings are half days; the other grading boundaries do not mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: Are report cards issued on the last day of each grading period?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar gives grading-period boundaries, not report-card release dates. Check your school and FOCUS messages for when grades and report cards will be available.

faqs.question: Can school breaks be used to make up missed days?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district states that break days may be used as make-up days. The annual calendar does not give an activation order or announce which dates will be used. Follow district and school messages before treating a listed break as final.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF button for the 2026-2027 Board-approved calendar. The district’s School Calendars page links the current downloads. Check district announcements and your school’s messages for later revisions or weather-related changes.

about.dataSource: The district’s official 2028-2029 School Calendar PDF is the primary source. It prints Board Approved 2/18/25 and 178 total student days, with a Nine Weeks table and a color legend distinguishing student days, holidays, half days, professional development and teacher workdays.
about.processing: The full one-page calendar was checked as text and as a rendered image, including the color legend and oval boundary markers. The local file matches the current official download by SHA-256. Pre-year and post-year teacher workdays and the post-year Memorial Day holiday are omitted because no regular-year student attendance is affected. Nine Weeks boundaries are milestones, not closures; coincident half-day and final-day meanings share one event. No semester, exam, report-card, senior endpoint or ceremony dates are inferred. The 205 weekdays between the published first and last student dates, less seven fixed no-class weekdays and 20 scheduled break weekdays, reconcile to 178. Each printed quarter count also agrees with its dated attendance schedule. The make-up footnote is applied conservatively to all three named break ranges without inventing priority or activation. Conditional break days are outside confirmed closure IDs; continuous planning spans include only weekends and supported no-class weekdays, with no guaranteed weekday-off count. The Christmas caption says December 20-January 3, but December 20 has the Half Day fill and ends Q2. The blue holiday fill starts December 21, establishing the derived full-day no-class start. Preserve the caption conflict without converting the December 20 half day into a closure. October 9 PD falls within Q1, and there is no April PD. The two separately marked January workdays are combined as a derived January 4-5 range.
about.updates: The district calendar page, all three linked PDFs, current announcements and available school notices were reviewed October 19, 2026. The PDFs say that break days may be used as make-up days and that statutory changes can require revisions. Recheck school messages when arranging travel or care.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference follows the district student calendar. Confirm school-specific hours, transportation, childcare, separate programs and any later attendance changes directly with your school.

faqs.question: When does school start in Escambia County for 2028-2029?
faqs.answer: Students begin Thursday, August 10, 2028. Employee workdays before that date are not student attendance days.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in 2029?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Wednesday, May 23, 2029, and it is a half day. It also ends the fourth nine weeks. Check your school’s dismissal time before arranging pickup.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2028?
faqs.answer: The district calls it Fall Break: November 20-24, 2028. Including the surrounding weekends, students are scheduled away from regular classes November 18-26, 2028 and return Monday, November 27, 2028. Break days may be used for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: When is winter break, and when do students return in 2029?
faqs.answer: Students have a half day December 20, 2028. Full days away from regular classes begin December 21, and the Christmas holiday continues through January 3, 2029. January 4-5 are teacher workdays, followed by the weekend. Students return Monday, January 8. Break days may be used for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2029?
faqs.answer: Spring break runs March 26-30, 2029. The scheduled return is Monday, April 2, 2029. With both weekends, the planned time away from regular classes is March 24-April 1, 2029. The district may use break days for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: Does the fourth nine weeks begin after spring break?
faqs.answer: No. The fourth nine weeks begins March 12, 2029. The regular March 12-16 and March 19-23 school weeks come before the March 26-30 spring break.

faqs.question: Which teacher workdays and professional-development days have no school for students?
faqs.answer: October 9, 2028, and February 19, 2029, are professional-development days with no school for students. January 4-5 are teacher workdays. The calendar does not list an April professional-development day.

faqs.question: Does the October 9 professional-development day end the first quarter?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off October 9, 2028, but the first nine weeks continues through October 13. The second nine weeks begins October 16.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day and Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no classes on Labor Day, September 4, 2028, or Veterans Day observed, November 10, 2028.

faqs.question: Is there school on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2029?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, January 15, 2029, is a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Is Presidents Day a student holiday?
faqs.answer: Students have no school on Monday, February 19, 2029. The calendar labels that date a Professional Development Day, rather than a teacher and student holiday.

faqs.question: Which dates are half days?
faqs.answer: The two half days are December 20, 2028, and May 23, 2029. Students attend on both dates; neither is a full day off.

faqs.question: Do students attend school on December 20, 2028?
faqs.answer: Yes. December 20 is a half day and the end of the second nine weeks. The Christmas-break caption also includes that date, but the student schedule marks attendance that morning. Full days off begin December 21; check for any later district correction.

faqs.question: What time do schools dismiss on the 2028-2029 half days?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar gives the dates but no dismissal times. Confirm the 2028-2029 half-day schedule with your school; current campus times for earlier school years should be rechecked.

faqs.question: How many student days are on the calendar?
faqs.answer: The district prints 178 student days. Half days remain student attendance dates. The published schedule may change if break days are needed for make-up instruction.

faqs.question: When do the nine-week grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four grading periods end October 13, 2028; December 20, 2028; March 9, 2029; and May 23, 2029. The second and fourth endings are half days; the other grading boundaries do not mean students have the day off.

faqs.question: Are report cards issued on the last day of each grading period?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar gives grading-period boundaries, not report-card release dates. Check your school and FOCUS messages for when grades and report cards will be available.

faqs.question: Can school breaks be used to make up missed days?
faqs.answer: Yes. The district states that break days may be used as make-up days. The annual calendar does not give an activation order or announce which dates will be used. Follow district and school messages before treating a listed break as final.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: Use the official PDF button for the 2028-2029 Board-approved calendar. The district’s School Calendars page links the current downloads. Check district announcements and your school’s messages for later revisions or weather-related changes.

sourceDiscrepancies.effect: The Christmas Break caption starts December 20, but that date is visibly a Half Day and the printed end of the second nine weeks. Blue holiday shading starts December 21. Retain December 20 as a half-day attendance date and derive December 21 as the full-day no-class start; do not add an extra closure or change the printed 178-day total.
